messages:
anya: heads-up — starting ~04:10 we've been seeing a wave of GPU pod evictions in us-west1c during warm-pool scale-ups. pods with nodeAffinity: gpu:high are getting bounced repeatedly.

dmitri: ugh, saw that. numbers?

anya: eviction rate spiked to ~8/min for 20m. tail latency for small inferences jumped too.

sam: any respect to taints? is this the soft-reserve we rolled last week?

anya: looks like it. nodes coming up have taint key `reserved-gpu:soft` and the scheduler is placing non-reserved tiny-gang pods then evicting when reserved requests land.

maria: can you paste a scheduler log snippet?

anya: sure — here's the relevant bit:

```
I0321 04:12:23.123456 1 scheduler_binder.go:245] binding pod default/model-worker-7 to node us-west1c-gpu-23
I0321 04:12:23.456789 1 evictions.go:78] evicting pod default/small-batch-12 from node us-west1c-gpu-23: fitsBetter=false reserved-gpu-claim=true
I0321 04:12:24.001234 1 preemptor.go:312] preempting pods on node us-west1c-gpu-23 for pod default/model-worker-7: reason=taint-toleration-mismatch
```

lee: that preempt logic should prefer draining non-gang pods out of warm pool first, not evict them mid-run. think our scoring weights changed in the soft-reserve PR.

sam: iirc we lowered taintPenalty weight to reduce cold start queueing. maybe too aggressive.

anya: consequence is a churn loop: warm pool scales up -> scheduler fills with best-effort small pods to get throughput -> reserved/gpu pods arrive and evict those -> warm pool thinks it's underutilized and scales further.

opsbot: Deploy 1758 (soft-reserve-adjust) created 3 hours ago by ci/CD.

maria: timeline fits. can we temporarily pause warm-pool auto-fill?

sam: yes — set warmpool.fill=false for us-west1c in the control plane. that'll reduce fill-greedy scheduling.

dmitri: also add a short-term rule to pin `reserved-gpu` taint to prefer-reserve when model pods are pending: `scheduler.alpha.kubernetes.io/preferReserved=true` (we can flip it on per-az).

lee: quick mitigation planned: 1) pause warmpool fill in us-west1c, 2) revert taintPenalty change in soft-reserve branch, 3) add conservative warmpool cooldown from 60s to 180s.

anya: i'm doing 1 now.

opsbot: Warm pool fill toggled OFF for cluster us-west1c by anya at 04:22.

anya: after toggling — eviction rate down to ~1/min over the last 5m, tail latency improving.

maria: good. for postmortem: we should quantify cost tradeoff of fill=false (more cold starts) vs eviction churn (wasted GPU cycles). we may need an AZ-aware policy that respects reserved reservations.

sam: agree. also add metrics: evictions_by_reason, warmpool_fill_rate, gpu_seconds_wasted_eviction.

dmitri: can we simulate this in the staging scheduler with a mix of tiny best-effort vs reserved gang workloads? want to reproduce before changing weights.

lee: i'll spin up a staging run with 200 tiny pods hitting warm-pool and staggered model-worker arrivals. aim to reproduce the spiral in <1hr.

anya: note: this was amplified in us-west1c because of constrained NVLink topology — packing failed to find alternate nodes and forced local preempts. we'll include topology constraints in sim.

maria: action items:
- anya: collect 24h eviction-rate and gpu-wasted-seconds (due EOD)
- lee: run staging sim and share artifacts (due tomorrow)
- dmitri: prepare patch to increase taintPenalty and add az-level preferReserved flag (PR draft by EOD)
- sam: add new observability panels and alert for eviction_spike/eviction_reason=reserved_claim (PR by tomorrow)

anya: noted. rough ETA for full fix? ~2-3 days if sim agrees.

sam: thanks folks. leaving notes in the runbook and pinging oncall to keep warmpool paused until mitigations land. :thumbsup:

opsbot: oncall ping sent to #eng-oncall at 04:35.

maria: good catch, anya. nice quick mitigation.

anya: np — i'll follow up with the graphs in a separate thread.
